This plot is not mine, I only rent it, so I will not put much money into it. Last season I used my own saved bean seeds and they gave me something to eat and a little to sell, so I will do the same again. Fertilizer bags cost too much and I have no cash to waste on someone else's land — I will just weed well with my wife and son, and maybe call one or two neighbors for a day when the weeds are heavy. The rains here in Tabora come once, so I cannot water the plot — I only plant when the rains start.
